facts.fact: UNCTAD ASYCUDA reports in June 2025 that ASYCUDAWorld is fully operational in all Equatorial Guinea customs offices, with Bata live since November 2024, the Malabo port since March 2025 and the Malabo airport since 2020, enabling paperless clearance.
